tool.name: 译维仓储管理
tool.description: 译维仓储管理工具，支持货品档案、出入库、库存盘点、条码与资金账单。业务数据按租户保存到独立服务器 SQLite 数据库，支持 JSON 备份、旧浏览器数据迁移和数据库下载。
tool.descriptionEn: Warehouse management with product records, inbound and outbound operations, stocktaking, barcodes, and accounts. Business data is stored in a dedicated server SQLite database per tenant, with JSON backup, browser data migration, and database download.
